subject: Re: Kickoff: DePlot chart QA for the analytics suite
body:
Decision time, since the LRB slot is June 25 and OKR lock is the 26th.

1. Stacked-area charts are out of scope for the demo and for the Q3 commit. Maren's numbers make the case: 71% structure match overall but under 40% on 8+ series stacked area. We demo bar, line, and pie.
2. No MatCha pretraining this half. It is the right long-term answer for derendering, but the compute ask does not fit the Cirrus allocation and I will not trade the demo for it.
3. Giannis, please have the Shipyard demo frozen by June 22 so Nadia's team can dry-run it.

Thanks all -- good half so far.

Anders
